visual_personality: Near-monochromatic. Warm off-white body (#faf9f7) against near-black ink (#111110). A single warm gold accent (#c8a96e) used with maximum restraint — italics in display type, check icons, quote marks, stat numbers. Nothing else.
typography_pairing: Cormorant Garamond (display serif, weights 300/400/600) for all headlines, pull-quotes, and italic moments. DM Sans (geometric sans, weights 300/400/500) for all body text, labels, and navigation. The contrast between these two voices is the entire typographic personality of the site.
spacing_philosophy: Extremely generous. Section padding at clamp(5rem, 9vw, 10rem). Hero at min-height 92vh. Internal gaps at clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem). The site breathes. Cramped is a design failure here.
color_rules: No gradients in UI. Background alternates between warm off-white (#faf9f7) and warm pale (#f3f1ed). Dark sections use pure near-black (#111110). No accent on backgrounds — accent is ink only. Border color is #e0ded9 throughout.
component_vocabulary: Everything uses border-radius: 2px — almost sharp, deliberately restrained. Cards use grid of cells separated by 1px lines rather than individual card shadows. Section dividers are 1px solid var(--color-rule). No decorative elements. No icons except functional ones (check marks, arrows, contact icons). Images are the only decoration.
layout_patterns: Hero uses 1fr 1fr grid (text left, image right). About sections use 1fr 1fr alternating direction. Features and values use grid-of-cells pattern (grid separated by 1px lines, cells with hover bg change). Process steps use 4-column with a horizontal rule as visual connector. No centered hero on homepage.
image_treatment: Images as contained objects in bordered/shadowed wrappers, not full-bleed bleeds (except project-banner). All images use object-fit: cover with overflow: hidden. Hover state zooms image slightly (scale 1.04–1.05). Images are the portfolio — they must dominate.
animation_personality: Slow and deliberate. Reveal transitions at 0.9s with expo-out easing. Hover transitions at 0.2–0.3s. Image zoom at 0.8s. No floating, no gradient animation, no bouncing. Everything settles, nothing shakes.
anti_patterns: No gradients. No rounded corners beyond 2px. No shadows on cards (use border/grid instead). No stock photo feel — gallery images must feel editorial. No centered page headers with cramped text. No color other than the defined palette.
navigation: Sticky with 72px height. Goes from transparent border to 1px rule on scroll. Logo uses display font Cormorant, accent letter in gold. Desktop nav uses uppercase 0.8rem tracking. Mobile uses full-screen dark overlay with enormous italic Cormorant Garamond links — the inverse personality of the desktop nav.
